message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths (directories and files passed via --dataPath); there is no remote/network source fetching and therefore no checksum, signature, or authentication mechanism is present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only filters out labels not in DAMAGE_TYPES but does not check for label distribution anomalies, compare label distributions across splits, or use any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs basic null/geometry checks but does no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any other mechanism to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via pickle (load_obj uses pickle.load) and saves/loads a best_model_wts.pkl file, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed on the loaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code filters samples by damage type membership in DAMAGE_TYPES but never checks class balance, distribution statistics, or flags anomalous label ratios before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, neural-cleanse-style trigger scanning, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is a standard Adam (torch.optim.Adam) with no DP-SGD wrapping, Opacus, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data at the code level, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the test split is loaded from a shared cached file alongside training splits.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads images and GeoJSON data without validating input shapes, pixel value ranges, or schema correctness before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code inspects model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or threshold sanity before returning or logging results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision/damage-assessment model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
